english.note: Use 廢話 as the all-purpose choice for silly, illogical, or pointless talk.

exampleSentences.english: Why are you talking so much nonsense?
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 gong2 gam3 do1 fai3 waa6 zou6 mat1

english.note: Use this for nonsense or an answer that is meaningless rubbish rather than merely incorrect.

exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 gong2 di1 fai3 waa6 laa1

english.note: Use this for rubbish that consists of nonsense or pointless talk.

exampleSentences.english: I don't want to listen to your rubbish.
exampleSentences.traditional: 你講嗰啲廢話我唔想聽。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 gong2 go2 di1 fai3 waa6 ngo5 m4 soeng2 teng1

english.note: Use 廢話 when ball means nonsense or bullshit, especially in an informal dismissal.
Use 廢話 when “stuff” means foolish talk, that is, nonsense or rubbish.

exampleSentences.english: The stuff you're saying is really ridiculous.
exampleSentences.traditional: 你講嗰啲廢話真係離譜。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 gong2 go2 di1 fai3 waa6 zan1 hai6 lei4 pou2

english.note: Use this for garbage meaning nonsense or meaningless talk, especially when describing words, claims, or a translation.

exampleSentences.english: Stop talking garbage; I want to hear the main points.
exampleSentences.traditional: 你唔好再講啲廢話啦，我要聽重點。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 zoi3 gong2 di1 fai3 waa6 laa1 ngo5 jiu3 teng1 zung6 dim2
